label: DSP reporting reach comparison rework
author: Rushali
description: Merges Weekly Reach Split into Weekly Cumulative vs Theoretical Reach and adds a persistent Weekly header tag plus v1/v2 switcher.
changesFromPrevious: Merged Weekly Reach Split with Weekly Cumulative vs Theoretical Reach.
Embedded retainer/newcomer/churner split in the cumulative side of the comparison visualization.
Added a Weekly pill to the merged column header.
Added a bottom-centered v1/v2 iteration switcher.
feedbackAddressed: Make real-vs-theoretical reach comparison easier by colocating the weekly split with the comparison metric.
Make the weekly-only nature of the metric explicit so granularity changes are less jarring.
